facts.fact: Chad's February 2026 submission to the ITU says its only operational international link runs through Cameroon, while the 1,142 km N'Djamena-Sudan border link is no longer working because of the war in Sudan.

TCD.note: The Chad-Nigeria letter of interest to the World Bank of 13 November 2026 is a first approach, not a financing agreement; Algeria and Libya links are talks and a requested feasibility study.
Attendance at ITU PP-26 and talks with Algeria and Libya are not membership of an African digital-policy body or a signed digital-policy agreement.
